name: hou_mcp_shell_audit
description: Generate a structured audit report from a completed shell_json. Reports floor_exists, wall_count, ceiling_exists, door/window/beam attachment counts, environment_ready, environment_valid, geometry_valid, and production_ready. Accepts optional semantic_valid and plausibility_valid from downstream validators.
python_code:
import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.environment_shell import EnvironmentShell, get_environment_shell_auditor

class Hou_Mcp_Shell_Audit(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_shell_audit"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("shell_json",          "string", widget_type="text",     default="{}")
        self.add_input("semantic_valid",      "bool",   widget_type="checkbox", default=True)
        self.add_input("plausibility_valid",  "bool",   widget_type="checkbox", default=True)
        self.add_input("required_wall_count", "int",    widget_type="int",      default=4)
        self.add_output("audit_json")
        self.add_output("environment_valid",  "bool")
        self.add_output("geometry_valid",     "bool")
        self.add_output("semantic_valid",     "bool")
        self.add_output("plausibility_valid", "bool")
        self.add_output("production_ready",   "bool")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        raw             = (inputs.get("shell_json") or "{}").strip()
        semantic_valid  = bool(inputs.get("semantic_valid",     True))
        plaus_valid     = bool(inputs.get("plausibility_valid", True))
        required_walls  = int(inputs.get("required_wall_count") or 4)
        try:
            shell_dict = json.loads(raw)
        except Exception:
            shell_dict = {}
        try:
            shell = EnvironmentShell.from_dict(shell_dict)
            audit = get_environment_shell_auditor().audit(
                shell,
                required_wall_count = required_walls,
                semantic_valid      = semantic_valid,
                plausibility_valid  = plaus_valid,
            )
            return {
                "audit_json":        json.dumps(audit.to_dict(), sort_keys=True, indent=2),
                "environment_valid": audit.environment_valid,
                "geometry_valid":    audit.geometry_valid,
                "semantic_valid":    audit.semantic_valid,
                "plausibility_valid": audit.plausibility_valid,
                "production_ready":  audit.production_ready,
                "exec_out":          True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"hou_mcp_shell_audit failed: {exc}")
            return {"audit_json": "{}", "environment_valid": False, "geometry_valid": False, "semantic_valid": False, "plausibility_valid": False, "production_ready": False, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Shell_Audit
